data.summary: The FR-001 Card transaction fraud detector model has been independently validated for its ability to identify fraudulent financial transactions. Key performance indicators show a Gini — test of {{m:run_5049de:gini.test}}, a Gini — out-of-time of {{m:run_5049de:gini.oot}}, a KS — out-of-time of {{m:run_5049de:ks.oot}}, an AUC — hold-out of {{m:run_5049de:auc.holdout}}, a Brier score — hold-out of {{m:run_5049de:brier.holdout}}, a Predicted × observed — hold-out of {{m:run_5049de:calibration_ratio.holdout}}, and an Observed outcome rate — hold-out of {{m:run_5049de:bad_rate.holdout}}. At the coded threshold the model achieves a Recall at coded threshold of {{m:run_5049de:recall_at.holdout}}, a Precision at coded threshold of {{m:run_5049de:precision_at.holdout}}, an Average precision (PR-AUC) of {{m:run_5049de:avg_precision.holdout}}, and an Alert rate of {{m:run_5049de:alert_rate.holdout}}. The validation identified {{m:run_5049de:findings.high}} high‑severity finding, {{m:run_5049de:findings.medium}} medium‑severity finding, for a total of {{m:run_5049de:findings.total}} findings, and parity checks report {{m:run_5049de:coef_max_abs_diff}} for coefficient maximum absolute difference, {{m:run_5049de:score_max_abs_diff}} for score maximum absolute difference, and {{m:run_5049de:rows_compared}} rows compared. Overall rating is Requires remediation before continued use.
